text: In one day, a free Chinese app wiped about five hundred and ninety billion dollars off Nvidia!
How can one app do that?
Investors believed AI needed ever more Nvidia chips. DeepSeek seemed to prove otherwise.
In January twenty twenty-five, the Hangzhou start-up released a free model it said rivalled the best in America.
It said its final training run cost about five point six million dollars in rented chips. Analysts say the real total was far higher.
It trained on H eight hundreds, the slower chips Nvidia made for China.
Its app jumped to number one in America, ahead of ChatGPT.
So did the chip bans fail?
Experts say they leaked, not failed. And in twenty twenty-six, DeepSeek's new model was released to run on Chinese Huawei chips.

That's how one free app wiped five hundred and ninety billion dollars in a day.
